baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Orcs & Goblins army book (Warboss-led mobs, Gork and Mork shamans, goblins bullied by orcs); TW:WH3 greenskin tribes
baseline.why: A greenskin horde is run by the strongest Warboss with shamans of Gork and Mork; no bureaucracy or schooling, tribute taxed at the mob's pleasure, captives and goblins enslaved; orc and goblin warbands are ruled by a Warboss (law_chiefdom, gov_greenskin_warband; #9037)
